purpose: Independent one-day historical point-forecast and availability-boundary slice; descriptive only.

shared_ridge10_consumer.features: 96 store-item indicators; 56 item-weekday indicators; 8 item time trends in 30-day units from 2026-05-01; 8 item announced-promotion values; one global holiday value scaled by 0.3; nonnegative prediction truncation
shared_ridge10_consumer.unknown_promotion: mean announced promotion by item in training rows from the preceding 56 calendar days, then zero

weekly_median56_consumer.window: 56 calendar days before origin through the day before target
weekly_median56_consumer.statistic: median demand grouped by store, item, and Monday-zero weekday
fallback_order: item-weekday median across stores in same window

frozen_metrics: mean signed error units per pair
frozen_boundary_assertions: Training labels use only revisions available at or before origin and service dates earlier than origin.
At least one actual training key has a later report row published after origin; the fitted snapshot must retain the earlier visible revision.
All 96 target labels are selected only at the evaluation cutoff; target labels are not model inputs.
Promotion features use only rows announced at or before origin.
scope_limits: one origin and one target date; not a fold ranking or generalization claim
point forecasts only; no nominal 90% interval, stochastic scenario calibration, or replenishment optimization
no full 42-day production, sensitivity, paper, acceptance, or reliability claim
